# Why did my Mailchimp audience import skip contacts or create odd fields?

> Free Mailchimp audience import CSV checker: finds invalid and duplicate emails, rows with no email, unquoted commas in Tags, birthdays with a year or mixed DD/MM and MM/DD, mixed date formats, phones Excel damaged and near-miss column names, with line numbers, and applies formatting-only safe fixes.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
